evidence.detail: The class is an abstract subclass of R111 ClientOverlay and adds exactly one abstract boolean a(int) interaction hook.
R111 ClientOverlay registration places every subclass of rs/l/e/a into a dedicated interactive-overlay list in addition to the ordinary render registry.

Client menu-building iterates that interactive-overlay list, requires the overlay to be active, calls a(currentMouseOrActionValue), and aborts ordinary menu construction immediately when the overlay returns true.

candidates.note: InteractiveClientOverlay is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the ClientOverlay subclass that can intercept client menu/input processing. No surviving original source noun is asserted; confidence is 0.998.

evidence.detail: The HIGH-layer draw path preserves the exact labels 'Coords: @gre@' and 'Region ID: @whi@'.
It derives world X/Y from the local player coordinates plus Client map-base offsets, then derives regionX = worldX >> 6, regionY = worldY >> 6 and regionId = regionX * 256 + regionY.
The overlay renders only in the R111 HIGH OverlayLayer and adjusts screen placement around other active overlays/resizable layout state.
Its visibility predicate is the live client setting flag rs/f/a.ao, so the overlay is conditionally enabled rather than dead diagnostic code.

candidates.note: WorldCoordinateOverlay is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the live coordinate/region diagnostic overlay. No surviving original source noun was found; confidence is 0.998.

evidence.detail: The live client command parser handles 'edit' by enabling this singleton and optionally resolving a supplied interface child ID.
Its draw text preserves '@gre@X', '@cya@Y', '@yel@Hovered', 'ID' and 'Parent', while its resolver walks the currently opened interface tree to locate the requested child and parent/index coordinates.

While active, keyboard handling for arrows/WASD mutates the selected interface child's X/Y offsets in the live widget arrays and marks the interface for redraw; Tab/escape-style input disables the editor.
The resolver emits '[ERROR] No opened interface to reference!' and '[ERROR] Could not find child ID ... in interface ...!' when the requested widget cannot be resolved.

candidates.note: InterfaceEditorOverlay is fixed by the exact 'edit' command, live widget coordinate mutation and ID/Parent hover display. The English noun is descriptive but the role is exact; confidence is 0.999.
